reason: After #832 ordinary-merged the global mandatory executed-test coverage reconciliation with coverageBatchUnknownBlockers=0, add one mandatory WP0 behavior contract per independent uncovered release-critical family so all ten COVERAGE_GAP_PREREQUISITE rows become actually executed exact-head evidence. requiredSemantics: Prove supported Telegram and Facebook messaging driver capability parity at the public adapter boundary without treating intentionally unsupported Facebook personal-identity as messaging-capable.

Prove physical egress rejects missing persisted attempt identity before provider I/O and preserves platform/account/idempotency/generation/fencing identity when a valid persisted attempt reaches the physical handler.
Prove the public-to-durable-to-physical contract rather than merely checking function/file presence.
Use real Schema-23 SQLite state and canonical durable authorities to exercise create/start/heartbeat/succeed/fail/cancel/retry/dead-letter semantics.

Prove external WAITING_REMOTE semantics through the canonical fenced ExternalActionDispatcher/DurableExecution transition path; do not require restoration of the retired waitRemote convenience method when no live caller owns that API.
Prove event sequence integrity under the actual serialized write transaction boundary.
Prove heartbeat extends a long-running lease and a stale pre-heartbeat terminal writer is rejected while the current owner can terminalize.
Prove queue-admission failure after durable SCHEDULED persistence terminalizes the operation instead of stranding it.
Prove competing cancel/succeed observations cannot both win under generation/fingerprint/fencing authority.
Prove a newer inbound turn invalidates/cancels stale runtime generation and stale candidate commit authority across turn coordinator, runtime registry and gateway fences.
Prove deep-reply and repair paths use bounded runtime timeouts and deterministic failure families do not create an unbounded retry loop.
Enumerate canonical backend commands from shared contracts and prove every write outside the exact recovery/lifecycle/delete-credential allowlist fails closed in Safe Mode.
Prove caller write hints cannot downgrade a canonical write or promote a canonical read, and allowlist/prefix spoofing does not bypass command-owned classification.

mandatoryExecution.runnerBehavior: Automatically enumerates every tests/wp0/*.test.js file and executes each in an isolated node --test --test-concurrency=1 process.

ifAnyContractFails: Freeze the exact failing tests-only head as immutable causal RED evidence.
Classify every failure by family and exhaust the same-root Closure Matrix to unknownBlockers=0.
Do not modify, weaken, skip or delete the failing coverage contract.
Do not add production code under this authorization.
Open a separate exact-path production authorization only for the proven failing root; independent failing families may proceed in parallel.
ifAllContractsPass: Autonomously review the exact head and require P0=0/P1=0 with zero unresolved threads.
Run a later ledger-only coverage reconciliation to bind exact test blobs, runner, Stage job, exact head and PASS result and only then consider mandatoryExecutedTestCoverageComplete=true.

forbiddenSemantics: No production/runtime/source repair in this package.
No modification of tools/wp0/run-tests.js, workflows, routing policy, package/lockfile, dependencies, migrations or release packaging.
No source-string-only assertion may substitute for behavior where an injectable executable authority boundary exists.
No obsolete convenience method may be resurrected merely to match historical finding wording when current live callers use a canonical replacement authority.
No Known Finding status promotion, final Delta completion, packaged RC/UAT, release-ready or publish claim in this package.
